title: Avoid exposing HAVE_PLUGINS in the public API
description:
Intead *_regiter_plugin() is turned into a noop (with a warning).

Closes #17202.

notes.body: Would calling `report_warning()` from wsutil work better?  It'd pop up a dialog in Wireshark and print a message in other programs.

I don't think `report_warning()` would better, because with `ENABLE_PLUGINS=Off` there's no code path to invoke these functions from Wireshark. I see using `report_warning()` for issues end-users might understand and have some control over.
So, with this change, the lists of plugins exist even if we don't have plugin support, *but* those lists will always be empty?

That's correct. Adding or removing those extra guards to remove those empty lists is just a matter of taste, it doesn't (shouldn't) change anything.

I can add the extra HAVE_PLUGINS guards back, I prefer to avoid the clutter but either way is fine for me.
Sounds good to me.  Empty plugin lists don't add overhead worth worrying about, so if it simplifies the code, it's the right thing to do.

commits_data.title: Avoid exposing HAVE_PLUGINS in the public API
commits_data.message:
Avoid exposing HAVE_PLUGINS in the public API

Instead *_register_plugin() is turned into a noop (with a warning).

The test suit is failing with ENABLE_PLUGINS=Off (it was already failing
before and this patch didn't affect that).

Closes #17202.
